reasoning: This frontend dashboard demonstrates solid security practices with no hardcoded secrets and proper input sanitization through React's automatic JSX escaping and Zod validation. The application scores 18/25 points (72%). Strong areas include security (no credentials exposed), input handling (React escaping + validation), keyboard navigation (native elements), and form accessibility (proper labels). However, it lacks environment variable usage for API configuration, uses no semantic HTML tags (header, nav, main, section), and missing ARIA labels on icon buttons for screen reader accessibility. The color contrast is adequate with proper dark mode support. Overall, the codebase follows modern React best practices but needs improvement in semantic HTML structure and ARIA attributes for full accessibility compliance.
